race.title: Unibet Interactive Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: ZACHARY HICKES is the least exposed of these and found further progress when justifying strong market confidence at Wolverhampton 36 days ago. He's up 3 lb but should have more to offer so is fancied to defy the rise with the step up to 2m likely to suit. Tarbat Ness has been in excellent form with 4 wins this year and drew clear at Southwell, so is feared most. ZACHARY HICKES TARBAT NESS SQUIRE DANAGHER
race.bettingForecast: Tarbat Ness (7/4), Zachary Hickes (2/1), Environment Amigo (7/1), Mr Freedom (15/2), Provision (8/1), Squire Danagher (16/1), Majestic (20/1)
